name: Minumadai-Shinsuikoen
tagline: Otemachi in 48 minutes and Tokyo in 49 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000.
summary: The station is in Adachi City, where the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 48 minutes to Otemachi, 59 minutes to Shinjuku, 65 minutes to Shibuya and 63 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. The station stands 4.9 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.7 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 4.9 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 2.2 m to 4.9 m, a difference of 2.7 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 8 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 1 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 1 clinic and 3 pharmacies. No facility recorded as a hospital lies within 2.5 km of the station. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Nippori-Toneri Liner.
congestion: The ministry's congestion survey does not publish figures for Nippori-Toneri Liner. It covers the major commuter stretches, and this line is not among them.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥80,000 to ¥90,000 and 1K ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. 1LDK ¥90,000 to ¥100,000 and 2LDK ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. For One room, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: rent, commuting and the flood projection are all much the same.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi 3 minutes sooner than Minumadai-Shinsuikoen.

neighbours.lead: Toneri-Koen is ahead on how close the centre is, but Minumadai-Shinsuikoen is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: About 2 km away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi 7 minutes sooner than Minumadai-Shinsuikoen. One-room rents run about ¥9,000 lower.

People living alone who want to hold the rent down

People who want plenty of places to eat out
noiseSources: 尾久橋通り (a main road) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 4 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 7 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The number of points that fall inside the projected inundation area is about average for a station in the 23 wards.
leads.stationNote: Only the Nippori-Toneri Liner serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is low for the 23 wards.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
